resources.string: Built into your phone. Reads every language it knows.
Not right? Change it, so the right voice reads it.
What language is this book in?
Books in other languages keep their own voice.
The natural voices don\'t speak %1$s yet, so your phone\'s voice reads this.
Natural voices speak on your phone itself. Nothing you read is sent anywhere.

The natural voices come with Jacket and work without the internet. They are free to use, but must not be used to deceive or harm anyone, for example by passing a voice off as a real person. The full terms are in Settings, under Licenses.
This voice is too much for this phone. Tap to change it.
The natural voice couldn\'t start, so your phone\'s voice is reading.
Choose how your phone\'s own voice sounds.
Each book is read in its own language. Natural voices speak many languages; your phone\'s voice reads the rest.
While you read inside, the outer screen wears your book\'s cover. Close the phone and the cover stays on; stand it half-open and the page sits above the fold.
Pages lift under your finger and slide, curl or deal away. Press and hold any words to highlight them and add a note.
Pages turn like paper, two side by side when the phone is open. Or sit back and listen: natural voices read any book aloud.
Natural voices read any book aloud, each word lighting up as it\'s spoken. It keeps going with the screen off.
A few choices to start with. You can change them any time.
Once upon a time, a book found its reader.
Keep your book\'s cover on your home screen with Jacket\'s widget.
Add an EPUB, PDF, CBZ comic or text file. Jacket keeps a private copy, gives it real pages to turn, and can read it aloud in a natural voice.
